countedBy: lane #235 (opus) from the rectified panorama crops of landmark-brief.ts (artifacts/landmark-briefs/oude-turfmarkt-139/); ribbon convention; a door counts; alongM is metres from the front's viewer-left (north-west) end; heightM bands leave out the cellar lights and attic lights where noted. Not a blind count; the integrator may re-count.

facades.name: DNB north wing (Froger 1869)
facades.note: Panorama TMX7316010203-001174_pano_0000_002533 (2019) and -001975_pano_0000_001320 (2021). Four axes of tall windows on two storeys; the paired barred cellar lights and the frieze attic lights are outside the band. alongM crops the 0.2 m at the risaliet end where the centre return stands forward inside the depth band.

facades.name: DNB centre risaliet
facades.note: Panorama TMX7316010203-001975_pano_0000_001309 (2021). Three axes between the fluted pilasters, balustrades under the upper windows, pediment with the relief group above.

facades.name: DNB south wing
facades.note: Panorama TMX7316010203-001174_pano_0000_002538 (2019). Same order as the north wing.

facades.name: DNB south pavilion
facades.note: Panorama TMX7316010203-001975_pano_0000_001324 (2021). Painted lower storeys: two windows over one; the upper aedicule window between blind panels.

facades.name: UvA: three Vingboons houses under one cornice
facades.note: Panorama TMX7316010203-000354_pano_0001_000246 (2017) and -001975_pano_0000_001326 (2021). Nine axes, four window storeys over the white plinth with paired arched cellar lights.

facades.name: St. Bernardus (Laarman 1884), main front
facades.note: Panorama TMX7316010203-002543_pano_0000_000123 (2022) and -000354_pano_0001_000240 (2017). Ten axes on the first floor; the ground floor has the door and the carriage gate in the run, the top floor paired round-headed lights under blind arches.
